DESIGNED AROUND YOUR PROPERTY

Get to the cause of the problem.

If your gate has become unreliable, start with a clear description of the symptoms. The gate structure, operator, access equipment, and power supply may each affect operation. Repair options depend on the system and its condition.

What we’ll discuss

  • Gate and operator brand or model
  • Symptoms and when they occur
  • Visible damage or recent changes
  • Age and maintenance history
